local: Ouviram do Ipiranga as margens plácidas
De um povo heroico o brado retumbante,
E o sol da liberdade, em raios fúlgidos,
Brilhou no céu da pátria nesse instante.
english: The placid shores of the Ipiranga heard,
the resounding shout of a heroic people.
And the sun of Liberty in shining beams,
shone in the homeland's sky at that instant.

local: Desafia o nosso peito a própria morte!
english: If the pledge of this equality
we managed to conquer with strong arm,
in thy bosom, O Freedom,
our chest defieth death itself!

local: [[Brasil]], um sonho intenso, um raio vívido
english: O beloved,
idolized homeland,
Hail, hail!
[[Brazil]], an intense dream, a vivid ray

local: De amor e de esperança à terra desce,
Se em teu formoso céu, risonho e límpido,
english: of love and hope to earth descendeth.
If in thy beautiful, smiling and limpid sky,
the image of the [Southern] Cross blazeth.
Giant by thine own nature,

local: És belo, és forte, impávido colosso,
E o teu futuro espelha essa grandeza.
english: Thou art beautiful, strong, a fearless colossus,
And thy future mirrors that greatness
Adored land
Amongst a thousand others

local: Dos filhos deste solo és mãe gentil,
english: art thou, [[Brazil]],
O beloved homeland
Of the sons of this ground
Thou art kind mother

local: Ao som do mar e à luz do céu profundo,
Iluminado ao sol do Novo Mundo!
english: Beloved homeland, [[Brazil]]!
Eternally lying on a splendid cradle,
to the sound of the sea and in the light of the deep sky.
Thou flashest, o [[Brazil]], crocket of America,

local: Do que a terra, mais garrida,
Teus risonhos, lindos campos têm mais flores;
english: illuminated by the sun of the New World.
Than the most ostentatious land,
thy smiling, beautiful meadows have more flowers.
"Our forests have more life,"
"Our life" in thy bosom "more loves".
O beloved,
idolized homeland,
Hail, hail!

local: E diga o verde-louro dessa flâmula
– "Paz no futuro e glória no passado."
Mas, se ergues da justiça a clava forte,
english: [[Brazil]], of eternal love, may
the starry ensign which thou displayest be a symbol.
And may the laurel-green of this pennon say:
"Peace in the future and glory in the past."

local: Verás que um filho teu não foge à luta,
Nem teme, quem te adora, a própria morte.
english: But if thou raisest the strong cudgel of justice,
thou shalt see that a son of thine fleeth not from battle,
